notifications.title: The hourly watchdog runs only every 5-9 hours
notifications.detail: watchdog.yml is scheduled at minute 13 of every hour, but GitHub ran it 5 times in the last ~27 hours (4 Nov 09:04, 17:10, 22:36; 5 Nov 03:28, 12:14 UTC). The hourly view snapshots behind the dashboard's 'realtime' chart and the variant system's 48-hour views therefore have gaps of 5-9 hours, and owner alerts can arrive hours late. Tonight's auditor fix makes the 48-hour count interpolate across such gaps, so nothing is blocked; this is only about timeliness.
notifications.fix: Optional. 1. Check the Actions tab: Watchdog runs should appear about hourly. 2. If they stay sparse, either accept it, or trigger watchdog.yml from an outside scheduler (e.g. cron-job.org calling the workflow_dispatch API with a fine-grained token limited to Actions on this repo). Workflows are owner-only files.
